mapper.select: SELECT fnd07_issuing_entity_id AS issuing_entity_id, fnd07_issuing_entity_cd AS issuing_entity_code, fnd07_issuing_entity_nm AS issuing_entity_name, fnd07_issuing_entity_attach_cd AS issuing_entity_attach_code, fnd07_issuing_entity_face_value AS issuing_entity_face_value, fnd07_issuing_entity_settle_month AS issuing_entity_settle_month, fnd07_issuing_entity_nation_cd AS issuing_entity_nation_code, f_cdnm('EmpNationCode', fnd07_issuing_entity_nation_cd, '0', f_sysdate()) AS kuka_name, LOWER(fnd07_issuing_entity_use_yn) AS issuing_entity_use_yn, fnd07_issuing_entity_note AS issuing_entity_note, fnd07_company_id AS company_id FROM fnd07_issuing_entity a WHERE fnd07_issuing_entity_nm LIKE #{issuingEntityName}
